profile.headline: Software Engineer at Asana
profile.summary: I'm addicted to that "Aha!" moment when everything clicks and my code becomes part of a bigger picture. I recently started at Asana as a Software Engineer Apprentice and am excited to learn and contribute as an engineer.

positions.title: Support Specialist
positions.description: I worked for the Counseling Enriched, Therapeutic Nursery School, and Youth Empowerment Services, maintaining client records, keeping my teams supplied, and being flexible to solve problems when they came up.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description: Worked as a black-box tester for Dark Souls II on Xbox 360. I documented bugs in easy-to-understand English for translation into Japanese, and checked for bug regression every update. In the time leading up to release, I worked long hours to make sure we found as many bugs as possible before release.
